summary: Discover the role of a Cyber Threat Analyst. Learn how they protect organizations from cyber threats and enhance security measures effectively.
audienceIntro: This PECB Certified Cyber Threat Analyst course is particularly advantageous and intended for professionals who are directly involved in or responsible for an organization's cybersecurity posture and threat defense strategies. This course is designed for: Incident Responders managing and mitigating security breaches and cyberattacks. Security Operations Center (SOC) Analysts detecting and analyzing security events. IT Security Infrastructure Managers securing and overseeing IT environments. Security Managers and Directors defining and implementing organizational security strategy. Penetration Testers and Ethical Hackers seeking insights into advanced defensive techniques. Risk Management Professionals identifying and assessing cyber risks. Compliance and Governance Officers ensuring adherence to cybersecurity regulations. Cybersecurity Consultants advising on threat analysis and hunting program development. Digital Forensics Specialists investigating complex cyber incidents. Aspiring Cybersecurity Professionals building foundational and advanced threat analysis skills.
modules: Fundamentals of Cyber Threat Analysis and Frameworks
Threat Hunting Program Preparation and Execution
Threat Hunting Analysis and Knowledge Management
Building Cybersecurity Culture and Continual Improvement
prerequisites: A fundamental understanding of cybersecurity principles and concepts is the main prerequisite for participating in this training course.
